salary_details.details: SBI has specified an annual CTC upper limit for each post. The annual CTC is negotiable and depends on the candidate's experience, current emoluments in present employment and place of posting. The CTC upper range covers Fixed Pay plus Variable Pay/PLP (based on Performance Rating) plus other perks. The notification does not give a monthly salary figure. | Variable pay: Officers are eligible for Performance Linked Pay and Annual Increment based on the performance rating measured as per the Bank's Policy. Contract period: 5 years, renewable for another 4 years at the discretion of the Bank, subject to fulfilment of any conditions the Bank may stipulate. Leave: Officers engaged on contract (OECs) are entitled to 30 days of leave during the financial year, granted by the Bank for genuine and appropriate reasons. Notice period: The contract can be terminated at any time, without assigning any reason, by giving 2 months' notice from either side or by payment/surrender of 2 months' compensation in lieu. Transfer policy: The Bank may transfer OECs to any SBI office in India or depute them to associates, subsidiaries or other organizations. Requests for posting or transfer to a specific place or office may not be entertained.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates
followed by one or more rounds of personal/video interview and CTC negotiation. There is no written test mentioned in the notification.

Shortlisting: A shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank decides the shortlisting parameters and the number of candidates to be called. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give any right to be called for interview. The Bank's decision is final and no correspondence will be entertained. Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents. Interview: The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. CTC negotiation: The Bank may negotiate the CTC with shortlisted/provisionally qualified candidates either (a) at the time of the interview
on the same day after the interview process or on a later date. If negotiation is conducted separately
candidates are called in order of merit. A provisionally selected candidate who does not agree to the CTC offered is treated as having voluntarily exited the recruitment process
and the next candidate in merit may be considered. Merit list: Prepared in descending order of interview scores only. Candidates with the same cut-off marks are ranked by age in descending order.
The interview call letter or intimation will be sent by email or uploaded on the Bank's website. No hard copy will be sent. At the time of interview
and candidates must provide details of any pending criminal cases. The Bank may also conduct independent verification

Visit the official SBI careers page: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.

content_sections.heading: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Bank has announced 6 vacancies across 5 posts. All vacancies are listed as Regular, and no Backlog vacancies are shown. One vacancy (Central Operations Team (COT) Support, OBC) carries a horizontal PwBD vacancy under the Visually Impaired (VI) category. The number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to the Bank's actual requirement. Abbreviations used in the notification: UR – Unreserved; OBC – Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer); SC – Scheduled Caste; ST – Scheduled Tribe; EWS – Economically Weaker Section; VI – Visually Impaired; HI – Hearing Impaired; LD – Locomotive Disability; d&e – PwBDs as mentioned in Sec 34 (1) clause (d) & (e) of The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of the Government of India and the outcome of any litigation.

content_sections.heading: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria for the post as on the date of eligibility, which is 31.08.2026 for educational qualification, experience and age. The educational qualification prescribed is the minimum, and candidates must possess the qualification and relevant full-time experience as on the specified dates. Meeting the minimum criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.

content_sections.heading: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee and intimation charges (non-refundable) are ₹750/- (Seven Hundred Fifty only) for UR/EWS/OBC candidates. There are no fees or intimation charges for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Payment is made online through the payment gateway using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, etc. Transaction charges, if any, are borne by the candidate. Registration is complete only when the fee is deposited online on or before the last date. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded on any account and cannot be adjusted for any other examination or selection in future. If online payment is not completed in the first instance, candidates should make fresh attempts. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application is retained, and the fee paid for other registrations is forfeited.

content_sections.heading: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Salary (CTC) and Contract Period
content_sections.text: SBI has specified an annual CTC upper limit for each post. The annual CTC is negotiable and depends on the candidate's experience, current emoluments in present employment and place of posting. The CTC upper range covers Fixed Pay plus Variable Pay/PLP (based on Performance Rating) plus other perks. The notification does not give a monthly salary figure. Variable pay: Officers are eligible for Performance Linked Pay and Annual Increment based on the performance rating measured as per the Bank's Policy. Contract period: 5 years, renewable for another 4 years at the discretion of the Bank, subject to fulfilment of any conditions the Bank may stipulate. Leave: Officers engaged on contract (OECs) are entitled to 30 days of leave during the financial year, granted by the Bank for genuine and appropriate reasons. Notice period: The contract can be terminated at any time, without assigning any reason, by giving 2 months' notice from either side or by payment/surrender of 2 months' compensation in lieu. Transfer policy: The Bank may transfer OECs to any SBI office in India or depute them to associates, subsidiaries or other organizations. Requests for posting or transfer to a specific place or office may not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates, followed by one or more rounds of personal/video interview and CTC negotiation. There is no written test mentioned in the notification. Shortlisting: A shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank decides the shortlisting parameters and the number of candidates to be called. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give any right to be called for interview. The Bank's decision is final and no correspondence will be entertained. Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents. Interview: The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. CTC negotiation: The Bank may negotiate the CTC with shortlisted/provisionally qualified candidates either (a) at the time of the interview, individually, or (b) subsequent to the interview, on the same day after the interview process or on a later date. If negotiation is conducted separately, candidates are called in order of merit. A provisionally selected candidate who does not agree to the CTC offered is treated as having voluntarily exited the recruitment process, and the next candidate in merit may be considered. Merit list: Prepared in descending order of interview scores only. Candidates with the same cut-off marks are ranked by age in descending order. The interview call letter or intimation will be sent by email or uploaded on the Bank's website. No hard copy will be sent. At the time of interview, original documents are verified, and candidates must provide details of any pending criminal cases. The Bank may also conduct independent verification, including police records.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The State Bank of India (SBI) is conducting this recruitment drive for Specialist Cadre Officers on a contract basis under advertisement number CRPD/SCO/2026-27/25.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available across various posts including Head Sales, Central Research Team, Manager, Project Development Manager, and Central Operations Team Support.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for SBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 21 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for UR/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, EWS, and OBC category candidates is Rs. 750/-. SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for Head Sales?
faq.answer: For the Head Sales post, the minimum age is 40 years and the maximum age limit is 52 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Manager (Business Process) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Manager (Business Process) post must hold an MBA/PGDM from a Government recognised University or Institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SBI Specialist Cadre Officers?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications, personal or video interviews, followed by CTC negotiations for selected candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary varies by post, with an annual CTC upper limit going up to Rs. 199.00 Lakhs for senior positions like Head Sales.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I apply for the SBI SCO positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official careers portal of State Bank of India at https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.

faq.question: Q10. Is this job permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These positions under the Specialist Cadre Officers recruitment drive are offered on a contract basis for the Wealth Management & Premier Banking Department.
